notes.title: HAPPY HOLIDAYS AND WINTER STEAM SALE!
notes.content:
🎄✨ Happy Holidays from all of us at Chaotic Ravens! 🖤

As the year comes to an end, we want to thank you for being part of our journey with Love Me or Die. Yuki and her friends are here to bring some holiday cheer—though Yuki might be channeling her inner Grinch! 🎁

This season, we’re thrilled to share that Love Me or Die is 20% OFF during the Winter Steam Sale! If you haven’t experienced Yuki’s world of fame, mystery, and pixel art, now’s the perfect time.

Wishing you all a joyful holiday season and a fantastic new year ahead! 🌟

notes.title: Aesthetic additions
notes.content:
ADDED:

- Added new animals in the exteriors.
- Added NPC walking in the street.
- Now you can open the pause menu with the ESCAPE button.
- Now when you click outside Yuki's phone, it closes the pause menu.

FIXED:

- Fixed a bug, that when the Speech volume was set to 0, it didn't play the sound in the cinematics.

notes.title: Scroll text and sound updated
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We have added a [b]slider that affects only the sound of the text[/b]. It allows to lower/upgrade it or disable/enable it.

We have also [b]increased the speed of the text[/b], so now it will be displayed faster, at the same time, there is [b]no more delay to show the full text[/b], once the text is displayed if you click on it, it will show you the full text and you can jump to the next sentence.

Thank you very much for your opinions, we are taking note of everything and trying to incorporate it as soon as possible.

notes.content:
In this interactive event, watch as we explore the world of Yuki, a rising [b]idol[/b] entangled in [b]dark mysteries and social pressures[/b], while sharing [b]insights on the creative process, inspirations, and future plans.[/b]
You'll have the chance to ask questions in real-time and hear behind-the-scenes stories about how this [b]gothic, narrative-driven world[/b] was brought to life. This is the perfect event for fans who want a closer look at the making of the game and an insider’s view of what’s next.
Don’t miss this chance to connect with our team and fellow fans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174828/8ab04c1523be15aeeef4e2ba2722e60efa6b4090.gif[/img]

[b]About Love Me or Die[/b]
Love me Or DIe is a retro graphic adventure that blends fame, mystery, and sharp humor. Join Yuki in her quest to become the most popular idol in Kaótica, a city brimming with eccentric characters and hidden secrets. When a tragic twist derails her dream, Yuki will face a dark enigma that challenges everything she believes in. Solve puzzles, challenge rivals in tweet battles, and explore a pixelated world full of surprises and unexpected twists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174828/76145a39f55a8adc739a26c9b016d1df95dddd27.gif[/img]

[b]About the main character[/b]
Yuki, a lonely and misunderstood teenager, is fed up with being invisible to society. After a particularly disastrous day when both school and friends turn their backs on her, she decides to take a shortcut to fame by imitating a famous idol in a desperate attempt to gain recognition and acceptance. However, after a tragic incident during her first major performance, Yuki is drawn into a dark mystery that forces her to question everything she’s fought for. Abandoning her pursuit of popularity, she embarks on a dangerous investigation that could change everything.
